messages:
Frank (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: can we get a two-paragraph summary of the top reasons we won and lost deals last quarter? Leadership needs a crisp note for the board packet.

Hannah (PM): Short summary: Wins typically come from our Dedicated + SLA offering, transparent committed pricing, and clear privacy/KMS commitments. Losses usually trace to total cost vs self-host, requests for on-prem/air-gapped deployments, and lack of easy model pinning/rollback which hurts renewals.

Maya (CRO): Sales color: deals flip when we provide throughput numbers+migration plan. Two enterprise pilots last quarter required an on-prem option and didn't progress because procurement couldn't accept hosted-only.

Ellie (CS): Support signals: frequent requests for "pin to previous model" and escalations when quality drops after model updates. Also recurring notes about latency variance during peak windows. Those correlate with renewal friction.

Liam (Eng): Proposed product wins: short-term - add model pinning toggle and automated rollback on regressions; medium - lightweight on-prem runtime image with KMS hooks. Can draft RFC for pinning this week.

Ravi (Data): Quick metric preview from CRM tags (since 2025-09-01): sla_commit=11, pin_model=8, need_onprem=6. I can produce an "avoidable churn" estimate mapping lost deals to requested features by Tue.

Hannah (PM): Action items: Maya -> list 2 deals that hinge on on-prem (Tue). Liam -> RFC for pin/rollback (Fri). Ravi -> avoidable-churn estimate (Tue). Ellie -> anonymized ticket snippets (Wed). Ops-bot: create playbook folder.

ops-bot: created doc playbooks/win-loss/q4-summary by @Hannah

Frank (CEO): Excellent. Please make the board note one page with the avoidable churn number and the recommended 90-day focus. Thanks everyone.
